entries.summary: ### What the Codebase Proves `PROPERTY_CRAWL` is a three-layer product: a static PWA dashboard (v0) backed by an optional Node.js + PostgreSQL production server (v1), with a Next.js marketing site (v2) that hosts a live triage demo.

entries.title: Architecture & Runtime Environment
